summary: A Maps Evaluator will provide ground truth for digital mapping applications, verifying accuracy and safety of routes, business names, and opening hours.
responsibilities: Verify navigation of certain routes are accurate and safe
Check business names and opening hours are correct
Check distance from a starting point to an end destination is listed accurately
required_skills: Good working knowledge of search engines, map applications, and social media platforms
Strong ability to learn, understand, and apply multiple sets of different instructions
Experience with Pin Codes on the India Post website and street view applications
qualifications: Local knowledge of India, geography, and culture
benefits: Working from the comfort of your home office
